headline: Growth accelerates; margins lag

highlights: AL has raised its MHCV growth guidance from high single- digit to mid-teens for FY27.
Margin pressure could remain sticky in the near term due to commodity inflation; however, we expect price hike(s) and cost-control initiatives to partially mitigate this impact.
Strong traction in defence and spares sale could continue to support profitable growth.
Q2FY27: Operating performance slightly ahead of estimate AL’s reported revenue stood at INR 133.6bn (+39% YoY/QoQ), 3% ahead of our estimate.
valuation: The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: Demand outlook Domestic: AL indicated that strong replacement demand, GST cut-led improved economics and healthy infrastructure activities continue to drive demand momentum in the CV industry.

Downside risks • Lower-than-expected growth in CV industry. • Faster shift in modal share towards railways due to the dedicated freight corridor (DFC). • Increase in discounts / pressure on realisation due to higher competitive intensity.
